subject.title: [Feature]: Allow job-level model override for cron jobs using sessionTarget=main + payload.kind=systemEvent

question: Should main-session systemEvent cron jobs support a first-class model/provider override, and which single public API shape should own it?
rationale: The request changes public cron protocol plus provider/session routing semantics, so automation should not choose between `payload.model`, top-level job fields, or a `sessionOverride` block without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add one canonical job-level override
options.body: Define a single job-level override contract and pass it through validation and heartbeat execution for main-session systemEvent jobs.

options.title: Reuse payload.model on systemEvent
options.body: Extend the existing payload field as the smallest schema change, accepting that text-only system events also carry routing metadata.

options.title: Keep main systemEvent default-only
options.body: Document that cheap per-cron models require isolated or agentTurn jobs and leave main-session system events on their default model.

recommendation.title: Add one canonical job-level override
recommendation.body: Define a single job-level override contract and pass it through validation and heartbeat execution for main-session systemEvent jobs.

likelyOwner.reason: The current cron schema/type/normalization/main execution lines blame to recent Vincent Koc commits, and the choice is centered on that public cron API/runtime surface.
